feature: Opt-in bounded map-only support after a measured localization epoch reset
scope: Authored fixed planar routes and surveyed maps, synchronous body-XY LiDAR. No global initialization, automotive uncertainty or real-vehicle/real-time qualification.

runtime_contract.anchor: independently confirmed measured reset, never renewed by a scan
runtime_contract.requires: new post-reset accepted synchronous map measurement, age <= 0.2 s; healthy LiDAR/motion; finite covariance guard remains
runtime_contract.cutoff: GNSS stamp must be strictly after reset; confirming scan is initialization only
runtime_contract.terminal_interruption: Malformed/rejected GNSS or missing motion; accepted real GNSS may recover normally
runtime_contract.timeout: First frame after absolute expiry brakes if real GNSS absent; later real GNSS may recover through existing gates
runtime_contract.normal_handoff: Real GNSS switches to ordinary actual-GNSS-based map outage policy; no GNSS clocks/counters are minted
runtime_contract.default_compatibility: map_only_grace_s None and map_only_support None omitted; existing relocalization/default logs expected identical

review_notes: Existing GNSS/map outage flag retains its original actual-GNSS basis.
Relocalization attempt/ICP budgets and stopping rules unchanged.
Fresh map acceptance does not compel planner to drive; independent physical movement gate required.
Repeated, delayed, empty, failed and missing scans are covered by unit controls.
Stop/accuracy gates retain invalid-epoch global CLI failures.
Authored fixed planar route and map only, no automotive/real-time qualification.

repair.problem: Revision A health admitted map-only support but final independent control guard still received absent actual GNSS time, so frozen handoff trials moved 0 m before GNSS.
repair.fix: Send the qualified accepted map observation stamp to final control guard; keep all actual GNSS diagnostics unchanged.
repair.additional_negative_control_gate: Actual speed >= 1 m/s before fault, added before any revision B physical run
